question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS root_id,
        id AS current_id,
        1 AS depth,
        1 AS multiplier
    FROM packaging
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations GROUP BY contains_id)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.multiplier * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT id AS current_id
    FROM packaging
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations GROUP BY packaging_id)
),
final_combinations AS (
    SELECT pt.root_id, SUM(pt.multiplier) as total_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN leaf_items li ON pt.current_id = li.current_id
    WHERE pt.depth > 1
    GROUP BY pt.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) as average_total_quantity
FROM final_combinations
